title: beta-Sitosterol Enhances the Anticancer Efficacy of Oxaliplatin in COLO-205 Cells via Apoptosis and Suppression of VEGF-A, NF-kappaB-p65, and beta-Catenin.
authors: Khateeb, Sahar; Almutairi, Fahad M; Alalawy, Adel I; Obidan, Amnah; Albalawi, Mody; Al-Massabi, Rehab; Sagini, Hanan Abdulrahman; Abuzahrah, Samah S; Taha, Eman F S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-谷甾醇增强奥沙利铂对结肠癌细胞凋亡和血管生成抑制的作用，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Colon cancer (CC) is a common malignancy characterized by poor prognostic outcomes and considerable mortality. Oxaliplatin (OXP) is commonly used in the treatment of CC; however, its efficacy may be limited by side effects and the development of resistance. beta-sitosterol (beta-Sit), a phytosterol derived from plants, has been documented to be effective in the treatment of tumors. This study aimed to investigate the potential of beta-Sit to enhance the antitumor efficacy of OXP in COLO-205 cells, focusing on apoptosis induction and suppression of the vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A)/survival pathway. Molecular docking studies were performed to assess the binding affinity of beta-Sit with the target proteins B-cell lymphoma 2 (Bcl-2), phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K), and VEGF receptor-2 (VEGFR-2). COLO-205 cells were treated with OXP, beta-Sit, or a combination of OXP + beta-Sit for 48 h. The combination treatment substantially lowered the IC(50) achieved with 3.24 microM of OXP and 36.01 microM of beta-Sit, compared to 25.64 microM for OXP alone and 275.9 microM for beta-Sit alone, demonstrating a pronounced synergistic impact. The combined therapy altered the cell cycle distribution by decreasing the number of cells in the G0/G, S, and G2/M phases, coupled with an increase in the Sub-G1 population. Furthermore, apoptosis was augmented by a shift in cell death from necrosis to late apoptosis, as indicated by an increased BAX/BCL2 ratio relative to each treatment alone. Moreover, the inhibitory effect on angiogenesis was enhanced via the reduction of VEGF-A, and beta-catenin and nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB-p65) were suppressed, thereby preventing the growth and survival of resistant cancer cells. Additionally, molecular docking supported high binding affinities of beta-Sit to Bcl-2, PI3K, and VEGFR-2. This study highlights the potential of beta-Sit to enhance the anti-cancer efficacy of OXP in CC.
abstract_zh: 结肠癌（CC）是一种常见的恶性肿瘤，以预后不良和显著死亡率为特征。奥沙利铂（OXP）常用于治疗结肠癌；然而，其疗效可能受到副作用和耐药性发展的限制。β-谷甾醇（beta-Sit），一种源自植物的植物甾醇，已被记载在肿瘤治疗中有效。本研究旨在探讨beta-Sit在COLO-205细胞中增强OXP抗肿瘤疗效的潜力，重点关注凋亡诱导和血管内皮生长因子A（VEGF-A）/生存通路的抑制。进行了分子对接研究，以评估beta-Sit与靶蛋白B细胞淋巴瘤2（Bcl-2）、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）和VEGF受体-2（VEGFR-2）的结合亲和力。COLO-205细胞分别用OXP、beta-Sit或OXP + beta-Sit联合处理48小时。联合处理显著降低了IC(50)，达到3.24微摩尔OXP和36.01微摩尔beta-Sit，而单独使用OXP为25.64微摩尔，单独使用beta-Sit为275.9微摩尔，显示出显著的协同效应。联合治疗通过减少G0/G、S和G2/M期的细胞数量，同时增加Sub-G1群体，改变了细胞周期分布。此外，凋亡通过细胞死亡从坏死向晚期凋亡的转变而增强，这由相对于单独处理增加的BAX/BCL2比率所指示。而且，通过减少VEGF-A增强了对血管生成的抑制作用，并抑制了beta-catenin和核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB-p65），从而阻止了耐药癌细胞的生长和存活。此外，分子对接支持beta-Sit与Bcl-2、PI3K和VEGFR-2的高结合亲和力。本研究强调了beta-Sit在结肠癌中增强OXP抗癌疗效的潜力。
